claims.claim: India v Pakistan, T20 World Cup, MCG, 23 Oct 2022: Pakistan 159/8, India 160/6 won by four wickets off the last ball; Kohli 82* (53), 6 fours, 4 sixes
after 18 overs 129/4 (31 off 12); 19th over by Rauf: 1, 1, 0, 1, 6, 6 -> 28 needed off 8 before the fifth ball, 16 off 6 after the sixes
Rauf's first three overs 7, 9, 6 = 22 runs; 15 off the 19th

last over (Nawaz): 20.4 no-ball + six; 20.5 wide; free hit 20.6 Kohli bowled, three byes; Karthik stumped; wide; Ashwin single off the last legal ball; three of Kohli's four sixes in the final eight balls
archive, men's T20 with line and length (1632 balls, back of a length on the stumps, overs 17-20): six 8.6% (1 in 12), straight six 2.0% (1 in 51)
archive: men's T20 chases needing 25-31 off 8 balls with at most 5 down: 4 wins in 29 (small sample)

Rauf: three slower balls in the over; 'no idea that he can hit me down the ground off that length'; 'I don't think he can do that again' (Dec 2022 / Jan 2023); Kohli: 'Till this date, I don't know how I pulled off that shot' (Nov 2023)
